Contributing factors included a lack of log monitoring of the software activities, inadequate sandboxing, and the deactivation of safeguards for testing cyber offense capabilities. Hugging Face contained the breach of its infrastructure and publicly disclosed it. Of the at least 1,200 agents involved, 95% ran on a model referred to by OpenAI as "Internal Model 1".
